alerts.title: Diesel Danger Zone
alerts.why: Global diesel exporters hobbled by wars, driving up heating oil and diesel prices as markets search for demand destruction.

itemsSent.title: FGE NexantECA Sees Slim Chance of U.S.-Iran Deal
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz create a risk premium, though the market remains skeptical of immediate supply disruptions.

itemsSent.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
itemsSent.why: Stronger-than-expected labor data signals robust energy demand and reduces recession fears, supporting oil prices despite potential interest rate implications.

itemsSent.title: Trump’s Iran Strategy Reaches a Critical Crossroads After Midterm Defeat
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical uncertainty regarding Iran's nuclear program and potential supply disruptions provides a modest risk premium to crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Energy Aspects Slashes Forecast of China’s November Diesel Exports
itemsSent.why: Lower Chinese diesel exports tighten global supply, supporting middle distillate cracks despite potential for future upward revisions if domestic demand weakens.

itemsSent.title: Oil Traders Want U.S. to Release Sanctioned Tankers as Freight Costs Soar
itemsSent.why: Increasing tanker availability would reduce freight costs and ease logistical bottlenecks, potentially increasing the flow of sanctioned oil into global markets.

itemsSent.title: U.S. Nonfarm Payrolls Surge, Surpassing Expectations
itemsSent.why: Stronger-than-expected labor data suggests resilient U.S. oil demand, potentially delaying Fed rate cuts and supporting crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Hawkish Bank of England hikes rates, and there’s more to come
itemsSent.why: Higher interest rates strengthen the dollar and dampen economic growth, weighing on global oil demand expectations.

itemsSent.title: Singapore fuel oil stocks inch up 3% coming into November
itemsSent.why: Singapore residual fuel oil stocks rose slightly while middle distillates fell, showing diverging regional product balances with limited crude price impact.
